labeler.isolation_mode: cloud agent labeling from holdout fixtures only; no skill runtime, scorer, public tests, mutation, plan, history, PRs, or other labeler outputs consulted for labels

prohibited_sources_not_accessed.statement: Labels were derived only from GOLD_RUBRIC.md, cases.json, case-freeze.json, and the four PNGs. The following classes were not used as labeling inputs.
items: public/mutation/history/PR review text for case answers
other gold labeler outputs (gold-labeler-1/3, gold.json, adjudication)
incidental_metadata_observed: Directory listing of tests/blind/ and cloud-holdout/ (names only) to locate allowed fixtures
freeze_holdout.py schema fragments for exact gold-labeler document shape {labeler, labels}
designer-attestation.json top-level keys only, as a template for this attestation file shape

images.labeling_note: Image ratings rely on cases.json visual_conditions/legibility_notes plus pixel inspection; illegible regions were not token-guessed.

checks_passed: labeler metadata keys exactly {context_id, model_id, model_family, display_name}
overall equals max(responsibility, tone) with Red>Gray>Yellow>Green on rated routes
non-review routes Intake/Message-template mode have null ratings
topic/fact lists sorted unique; requiredsubseteq allowed; critical_invariants nonempty subset of rubric tokens
cases.json and four PNG sha256 values match case-freeze.json
four PNGs open as PNG and verify()

content_declarations.schema: Each label item is {case_id, turn_labels}; each turn includes route, responsibility, tone, overall, required_question_topics, allowed_question_topics, required_revision_facts, allowed_revision_facts, critical_invariants, rationale

limitations: Topic and fact tokens are concise canonical kebab-case chosen by this labeler; another isolated labeler may choose synonymous tokens.
Incidental schema discovery used freeze_holdout.py field sets to satisfy exact envelope validation without reading other label files.
